chapter_claims.topic: loss of continuous observations and access limitation
chapter_claims.required_control: spatiotemporal missingness map; distinguish missing data from absence of process
ship CTD observations have selection and weather-access bias

chapter_claims.topic: moving sea ice and ice-shelf cavities impede sampling
chapter_claims.required_control: record ice/under-ice field and availability of sensor telemetry

chapter_claims.topic: under-ice autonomous navigation and loss of Ran; exact cause unknown
chapter_claims.required_control: no causal classification of mission failure from data silence

chapter_claims.topic: beautiful global seafloor maps mask interpolated gaps
chapter_claims.required_control: IBCSO bed + TID + RID all required, interpolated cells cannot count as direct sonar soundings

chapter_claims.topic: circumpolar current, polynyas, dense water formation and winter bias
chapter_claims.required_control: lat x calendar month coverage bins and austral-season balance

chapter_claims.topic: Argo repeated profiles and under-ice delayed transmission with uncertain positions
chapter_claims.required_control: D-mode QC1 adjusted CTD separately from POSITION_QC8; transmission latency unknown unless timestamps explicitly measured

chapter_claims.topic: CTD profiles from elephant seals and other mammals
chapter_claims.required_control: MEOP external data source separate from Argo and source-specific QC

chapter_claims.topic: heterogeneous basal melting near Thwaites and stratification
chapter_claims.required_control: No melt rate prediction from isolated CTD profile without ice geometry, local freezing point, velocity, and independently measured interface

chapter_claims.topic: carbon and Southern Ocean circulation feedbacks
chapter_claims.required_control: register SOCCOM BGC Argo separately; check oxygen, nitrate, pH adjusted quality

chapter_claims.topic: complementary observatories and long time series
chapter_claims.required_control: provenance-by-sensor, uncertainty budgets and independent observation coverage

implementation.training_scope: retrospective float-disjoint only; models not promoted
warnings: This is a selected subset, not the full Argo archive
latitude-month zero means missing in sample, not zero ocean activity
Under-ice position-quality QC8 remains out of precise geolocation training
No claim of deep ocean or ice shelf hydrodynamic prediction from shallow CTD-only data

next_research: Use calendar-month x latitude stratified Argo sampling and independent holdout; then separate MEOP/SOCCOM/IBCSO data provenance gates; no automatic model promotion.
